title: ABNAH Supply Chain Control Tower Architecture
sourcePolicy: Schema metadata and planned mappings only. No screenshots, local paths, CSV rows, or operational values are stored in this contract.

currentPhase.label: Source feasibility and integrity validation
currentPhase.description: The selected Restroworks exports are being checked locally for structural drift, blank or shifted columns, invalid values, and business-rule exceptions before production mappings are approved.
currentPhase.nextGate: Promote planned routes into reviewed KPI lineage only after populated CSV evidence and key joins pass validation.

layers.label: Restroworks and master sources
layers.description: Selected report exports and authoritative master extracts.

layers.label: Immutable landing
layers.description: Source-shaped, append-only loads with file, period, filter, and audit metadata.

layers.label: Standardized business records
layers.description: Typed dates, canonical signs, preserved source positions, normalized identifiers, and quality flags.

layers.label: Conformed dimensions
layers.description: Shared outlet, item, vendor, date, UOM, recipe, and status identities.

layers.label: Atomic analytical facts
layers.description: Lowest defensible transaction, snapshot, forecast, and risk grains.

layers.label: Decision summaries
layers.description: Reusable KPI-ready aggregates with reconciliation and quality gates.

layers.label: Approved KPI definitions
layers.description: Business definitions from the four-page ABNAH requirement register.

layers.label: Control tower pages
layers.description: The four decision-oriented dashboard experiences delivered in Zoho Analytics.

groups.label: Sales, menu and recipe
groups.description: Menu demand, recipe dependencies, sales value and menu profitability.

groups.label: Inventory and consumption
groups.description: Stock position, movement, consumption, variance, wastage, expiry and replenishment.

groups.label: Procurement and capital
groups.description: Purchase orders, receipts, indents, liabilities and price movement.

groups.label: Vendor performance
groups.description: Vendor identity, price, receipts, returns and service risk.

groups.label: Conformed master data
groups.description: Stable outlet, item, vendor, UOM and status identities.

groups.label: Reconciliation and quality
groups.description: Aggregate controls and exception surfaces used to prove detailed facts.

sourceNodes.label: Gross/Net Margin Report
sourceNodes.description: Primary item-level sales and menu-margin source.
sourceNodes.logic: Keep settled item-level rows; exclude customer name and phone from normalized output.
alternatives: Bill Item Detail supplies timing and classification if a margin attribute is unavailable.

sourceNodes.label: Bill Item Detail Report
sourceNodes.description: Item classification, quantity, bill timing and outlet detail.
sourceNodes.logic: Retain item and bill grain; reconcile quantity and net sales to the margin source.
alternatives: Use as the primary sales fact only if Gross/Net Margin cannot be exported.

sourceNodes.label: Item Recipe Report
sourceNodes.description: Reviewed menu-item-to-ingredient bill of materials.
sourceNodes.logic: Snapshot active recipes and preserve menu-to-ingredient grain before UOM conversion.
alternatives: Recipe Consumption is transactional evidence and does not replace this bridge.

sourceNodes.label: Recipe Consumption Report
sourceNodes.description: Billing-driven recipe consumption output by period.
sourceNodes.logic: Export Billing operation without margin summary and compare to independently calculated theoretical consumption.
alternatives: Calculate theoretical consumption from sales multiplied by the effective recipe if this output is incomplete.

sourceNodes.label: Raw Material Item Detail
sourceNodes.description: Raw-material attributes and operational item identity.
sourceNodes.logic: Retain active and inactive values and create an unresolved item-identity queue.
alternatives: Use the Restroworks item-master API when it exposes stronger identifiers or missing attributes.

sourceNodes.label: Enterprise Consumption
sourceNodes.description: Detailed opening, movement, consumption and closing quantity/value pairs.
sourceNodes.logic: Interpret every repeated Amt by its nearest preceding measure and source position; never deduplicate labels.
alternatives: Reconstruct from atomic inventory movement plus checkpoints when the period report fails reconciliation.

sourceNodes.label: Enterprise Variance
sourceNodes.description: Normal enterprise ranking and store-level Master Variance reconciliation modes.
sourceNodes.logic: Store normal and master tabs as separate contracts; only Master Variance supports store-level closing-minus-physical validation.
alternatives: Use Enterprise Entry Physical Stock plus Closing Stock if Master Variance is unavailable.

sourceNodes.label: Enterprise Wastage Report
sourceNodes.description: Normal item-detail wastage view with stock and billing components.
sourceNodes.logic: Consumption is the denominator, not a component added into total wastage; validate source percentage from populated rows.
alternatives: Use Enterprise Entry Wastage mode for transaction evidence and reconciliation.

sourceNodes.label: Enterprise Entry
sourceNodes.description: Twelve stock transaction modes covering entry, transfer, return and physical stock events.
sourceNodes.logic: Load each mode separately and assign canonical movement direction and transaction type without losing source mode.
alternatives: Stock In Stock Out provides a compact directional cross-check.

sourceNodes.label: Closing Stock Report
sourceNodes.description: Outlet-store-item month-end quantity and inventory value checkpoints.
sourceNodes.logic: Keep one snapshot per month-end plus current MTD and reconcile to movement-derived closing.
alternatives: Enterprise Consumption closing is the period-level comparison source.

sourceNodes.label: Enterprise Stock Re-Order
sourceNodes.description: Available stock, reorder level and minimum-order reference.
sourceNodes.logic: Retain healthy rows as the comparison population; never treat a fixed reorder level as demand-aware stockout prediction.
alternatives: Use forecast demand and days cover when reorder values are blank or stale.

sourceNodes.label: Stock In Stock Out Report
sourceNodes.description: Compact stock movement and transfer direction report.
sourceNodes.logic: Normalize both directions into signed atomic movements while retaining from/to locations.
alternatives: Enterprise Entry is the primary multi-mode transaction source.

sourceNodes.label: Expiry Report
sourceNodes.description: Current batch or item expiry evidence for exact expiry risk.
sourceNodes.logic: Use exact batch expiry when present and apply signed-off risk windows.
alternatives: If batch evidence is absent, estimate from receipt age plus approved shelf life and label the result Estimated.

sourceNodes.label: Purchase Order Report
sourceNodes.description: Operational PO authority replacing the empty Enterprise Purchase Order screen.
dataPoints: Unit price, tax and total cost
sourceNodes.logic: Export every status separately, then union with source status preserved and one canonical open/closed state.
alternatives: Enterprise Purchase Order is excluded because the UAT report is empty.
Purchase Detail supplies actual receipt and invoice evidence.

sourceNodes.label: Standing Purchase Order Report
sourceNodes.description: Optional standing-order context when ABNAH uses releases and exposes linkage keys.
sourceNodes.logic: Ingest only when populated and a standing-PO-to-release-PO key is proven.
alternatives: Regular Purchase Order Report remains sufficient when standing orders are unused.

sourceNodes.label: Purchase Detail
sourceNodes.description: Received purchase, invoice and actual-price detail with PO fields enabled.
sourceNodes.logic: Use Purchase Detail mode with PO Details enabled and no aggregation; test PO-line linkage before OTIF use.
alternatives: Enterprise Purchase Summary is a monthly reconciliation control only.

sourceNodes.label: Enterprise Stock Return
sourceNodes.description: Vendor return quantity, amount and source-entry reference.
sourceNodes.logic: Normalize return signs and retain the original purchase or entry reference for rate denominators.
alternatives: Stock Entry Return Report may be identical and can be used after header equivalence is proven.

sourceNodes.label: ERP Vendor Price
sourceNodes.description: Published vendor-item price context and validity state.
sourceNodes.logic: Preserve effective dates and publication state; compare quoted price to actual receipt price without overwriting either.
alternatives: Purchase Detail provides actual paid-price movement if ERP price history is incomplete.

sourceNodes.label: Enterprise Consolidated Indent
sourceNodes.description: Request-side item demand before purchase-order creation.
sourceNodes.logic: Use request date for monthly flow and preserve requested, approved and converted-to-PO states.
alternatives: Enterprise Entry transfer requests support only a narrower internal-movement view.

sourceNodes.label: Enterprise Purchase Summary Report
sourceNodes.description: Monthly purchase aggregate used to reconcile detailed receipts.
sourceNodes.logic: Compare monthly totals to Purchase Detail; never replace atomic receipt rows.
alternatives: Investigate period, status and tax filters when aggregate and detail differ.

sourceNodes.label: Food Cost Report - Item Wise COGS
sourceNodes.description: Item-wise aggregate cost control dependent on physical stock entry.
sourceNodes.logic: Reconcile detailed consumption and COGS by month; mark periods without end-date physical stock provisional.
alternatives: Detailed consumption, variance and sales facts remain the KPI authority.

sourceNodes.label: Outlet Master
sourceNodes.description: Authoritative outlet identity and India geography extract.
sourceNodes.logic: Prefer API or authoritative CSV and map source deployment/store identifiers through an explicit bridge.
alternatives: Transaction-derived outlet lists are acceptable for POC only and cannot prove active status or coordinates.

sourceNodes.label: Vendor Master
sourceNodes.description: Authoritative vendor identity, coverage and active-state extract.
sourceNodes.logic: Prefer API or authoritative CSV and retain unresolved vendor-name mappings as data-quality exceptions.
alternatives: Transaction-derived vendor lists are acceptable for POC only.

modelNodes.label: RAW Sales Item
modelNodes.description: Source-shaped margin and bill-item rows.
modelNodes.logic: Append only; preserve source labels and row order.

modelNodes.label: RAW Recipe and Consumption
modelNodes.description: Recipe snapshot and billing consumption rows.
modelNodes.logic: Keep recipe snapshot and period consumption modes distinguishable.

modelNodes.label: RAW Item Master
modelNodes.description: Raw-material item snapshot.
modelNodes.logic: Version snapshots and retain source identifiers exactly.

modelNodes.label: RAW Inventory Period
modelNodes.description: Consumption, variance and wastage report modes.
modelNodes.logic: Preserve every repeated Qty/Amt pair by source position and report mode.

modelNodes.label: RAW Inventory Movement
modelNodes.description: Entry modes and stock in/out transactions.
modelNodes.logic: Retain source direction and mode before canonical signs are assigned.

modelNodes.label: RAW Inventory Snapshot
modelNodes.description: Closing, reorder and expiry checkpoints.
modelNodes.logic: Require explicit snapshot or as-of metadata on every row.

modelNodes.label: RAW Purchase Order
modelNodes.description: Regular and conditional standing PO rows.
modelNodes.logic: Union status files without collapsing source statuses or release relationships.

modelNodes.label: RAW Purchase Receipt
modelNodes.description: Detailed receipts plus monthly control totals.
modelNodes.logic: Tag detail versus control rows; control totals never enter atomic facts.

modelNodes.label: RAW Vendor Return and Price
modelNodes.description: Return transactions and vendor-item price snapshots.
modelNodes.logic: Keep transactional returns separate from effective-dated price observations.

modelNodes.label: RAW Replenishment Request
modelNodes.description: Enterprise indent request flow.
modelNodes.logic: Preserve request state and linked document references.

modelNodes.label: RAW Outlet and Vendor Masters
modelNodes.description: Authoritative non-report extracts.
modelNodes.logic: Version source snapshots and reject silent code reuse.

modelNodes.label: RAW Reconciliation Controls
modelNodes.description: Food-cost and purchase aggregate controls.
modelNodes.logic: Store separately from analytical facts and compare only at matching scope.

modelNodes.label: STD Sales Item
modelNodes.description: Typed and privacy-reduced item sales.
modelNodes.logic: Standardize dates and currency, remove direct customer identifiers, and flag duplicate bill-item keys.

modelNodes.label: STD Recipe
modelNodes.description: Canonical recipe and source consumption records.
modelNodes.logic: Resolve item identities and retain unresolved rows; do not convert UOM until an approved conversion exists.

modelNodes.label: STD Item Master
modelNodes.description: Canonical item attributes and identity candidates.
modelNodes.logic: Use codes first; normalized names produce candidates, never silent joins.

modelNodes.label: STD Inventory Period
modelNodes.description: Position-aware quantity/value measures and validation flags.
modelNodes.logic: Map repeated labels positionally, retain unlabelled variance fields, and reject column shifts.

modelNodes.label: STD Inventory Movement
modelNodes.description: Signed and typed atomic stock movement.
modelNodes.logic: Assign one canonical sign convention while retaining original quantity and direction.

modelNodes.label: STD Inventory Snapshot
modelNodes.description: Canonical closing, reorder and expiry snapshots.
modelNodes.logic: Distinguish exact batch expiry from estimated shelf-life dates and validate quantity-value arithmetic.

modelNodes.label: STD Purchase Order
modelNodes.description: Canonical PO line lifecycle.
modelNodes.logic: Validate quantity bridges and map statuses through an explicit status dimension.

modelNodes.label: STD Purchase Receipt
modelNodes.description: Canonical received purchase line.
modelNodes.logic: Separate control rows, standardize prices and test deterministic PO-line linkage.

modelNodes.label: STD Vendor Activity
modelNodes.description: Canonical return and price events.
modelNodes.logic: Normalize return signs and build effective-dated quoted-price observations.

modelNodes.label: STD Replenishment Request
modelNodes.description: Canonical indent request lifecycle.
modelNodes.logic: Preserve state transitions and test indent-to-PO linkage independently.

modelNodes.label: STD Business Masters
modelNodes.description: Canonical outlet and vendor records.
modelNodes.logic: Create explicit crosswalks and unresolved queues; never use hardcoded outlet unions.

modelNodes.label: DIM Date
modelNodes.description: Calendar, fiscal and period attributes.
modelNodes.logic: One shared India business calendar.

modelNodes.label: DIM Outlet
modelNodes.description: Stable outlet, store, geography and maturity identity.
modelNodes.logic: Authoritative master first; unresolved source locations remain visible exceptions.

modelNodes.label: DIM Item Identity
modelNodes.description: Canonical ingredient and raw-material identity with aliases.
modelNodes.logic: Code-based resolution with auditable candidate and unresolved states.

modelNodes.label: DIM Menu Item
modelNodes.description: Canonical sellable-menu identity and classification.
modelNodes.logic: Reconcile sales and recipe identities through explicit source keys.

modelNodes.label: DIM Vendor
modelNodes.description: Stable vendor identity, active state and service coverage.
modelNodes.logic: Master-driven identity with transaction-derived aliases retained for review.

modelNodes.label: DIM UOM Conversion
modelNodes.description: Approved item-specific conversions into base UOM.
modelNodes.logic: No inferred conversion enters production facts without explicit approval.

modelNodes.label: DIM Recipe Effective
modelNodes.description: Effective-dated menu-to-ingredient recipe bridge.
modelNodes.logic: Apply only approved identity and UOM mappings for the sale date.

modelNodes.label: DIM PO Status
modelNodes.description: Source-to-canonical PO lifecycle mapping.
modelNodes.logic: Business-approved status mapping; retain original source status.

modelNodes.label: FACT Sales Item
modelNodes.description: One settled outlet-bill-menu-item line.
modelNodes.logic: Deduplicate on proven business key and reconcile to source bill totals.

modelNodes.label: FACT Theoretical Consumption
modelNodes.description: Expected ingredient usage from sales and effective recipes.
modelNodes.logic: Sales quantity multiplied by effective base-UOM recipe quantity; compare to source recipe-consumption output.

modelNodes.label: FACT Inventory Movement
modelNodes.description: One signed item movement event.
modelNodes.logic: Convert to approved base UOM and preserve original source quantity.

modelNodes.label: FACT Physical Stock Count
modelNodes.description: One outlet-store-item physical count checkpoint.
modelNodes.logic: Prefer Master Variance store grain and preserve NA physical values as null.
alternatives: Enterprise Entry Physical Stock provides the fallback checkpoint.

modelNodes.label: FACT Actual Consumption
modelNodes.description: Observed item consumption at outlet-period grain.
modelNodes.logic: Use explicit source consumption and reconcile with movement and physical checkpoints.
alternatives: Derive from opening plus inflows minus outflows minus closing only after all movement types reconcile.

modelNodes.label: FACT Consumption Variance
modelNodes.description: Actual versus theoretical ingredient usage.
modelNodes.logic: Compare at compatible period, outlet, ingredient and base UOM; expose missing physical or recipe coverage.

modelNodes.label: FACT Inventory Wastage
modelNodes.description: Stock and billing wastage without double counting consumption.
modelNodes.logic: Validate total-wastage source logic from populated rows before percentage publication.

modelNodes.label: FACT Purchase Order
modelNodes.description: One canonical purchase-order line lifecycle.
modelNodes.logic: Open liability uses only valid open states and remaining quantity at the PO-line price.

modelNodes.label: FACT Purchase Receipt
modelNodes.description: One received purchase or GRN item line.
modelNodes.logic: Unmatched and ambiguous PO candidates remain excluded from OTIF denominators but visible in quality exceptions.

modelNodes.label: FACT Vendor Return
modelNodes.description: One vendor item return transaction.
modelNodes.logic: Return rate denominator uses matched received quantity over the same approved period.

modelNodes.label: FACT Vendor Price
modelNodes.description: Effective-dated quoted and actual vendor-item price observations.
modelNodes.logic: Compare prices only in the same normalized UOM and keep quote versus paid source distinct.

modelNodes.label: FACT Replenishment Request
modelNodes.description: One indent item request lifecycle.
modelNodes.logic: Measure request-to-approval and request-to-PO transitions only when keys are proven.

modelNodes.label: FACT Menu Demand Forecast
modelNodes.description: Forecast menu quantity and sales by outlet and horizon.
modelNodes.logic: Begin with historical regression and calendar features; publish confidence and back-test error with every model version.
alternatives: Use trailing average baseline until sufficient history is available.

modelNodes.label: FACT Inventory Risk
modelNodes.description: Projected shortage, days cover and expiry risk by ingredient.
modelNodes.logic: Count inbound only when valid open PO delivery precedes demand; separate descriptive pressure from predicted risk.

modelNodes.label: FACT Action Recommendation
modelNodes.description: Prioritized owner-ready supply actions.
modelNodes.logic: Deterministic severity and action rules first; optimization remains deferred until constraints are approved.

modelNodes.label: SUM Demand Forecast
modelNodes.description: Outlet and menu forecast rollups with model quality.
modelNodes.logic: Aggregate only within a single forecast version and horizon.

modelNodes.label: SUM Risk Action
modelNodes.description: Highest-severity risk and next action by outlet and ingredient.
modelNodes.logic: One deterministic highest-severity row per outlet-risk scope.

modelNodes.label: SUM Stockout Risk
modelNodes.description: Projected shortage and revenue exposure.
modelNodes.logic: Prevent menu-sales double counting across shared ingredients by an approved allocation rule.

modelNodes.label: SUM Expiry Risk
modelNodes.description: Exact or estimated near-expiry stock value.
modelNodes.logic: Always expose exact versus estimated evidence type.

modelNodes.label: SUM Inventory Position
modelNodes.description: Closing stock quantity, value and working-capital view.
modelNodes.logic: Reconcile snapshots to movement-derived closing before publication.

modelNodes.label: SUM Procurement Funnel
modelNodes.description: Request, PO, receipt and liability lifecycle.
modelNodes.logic: Use only deterministic joins in conversion, fill and delay denominators.

modelNodes.label: SUM Vendor Performance
modelNodes.description: Vendor delivery, return and coverage performance.
modelNodes.logic: Block OTIF when expected date or PO-line receipt linkage coverage is below the approved gate.
alternatives: Show descriptive receipt and return trends while OTIF is blocked.

modelNodes.label: SUM Price Movement
modelNodes.description: Actual and quoted vendor-item price trends.
modelNodes.logic: Compare like-for-like UOM, tax basis and vendor-item scope.

modelNodes.label: SUM Financial Leakage
modelNodes.description: Combined purchase-price, return, wastage and consumption leakage.
modelNodes.logic: Keep components additive only when definitions and periods do not overlap; publish evidence coverage.

modelNodes.label: SUM Consumption Variance
modelNodes.description: Actual, theoretical, low and excess consumption.
modelNodes.logic: Aggregate only at compatible base UOM and separate low from excess consumption.

modelNodes.label: SUM Menu Profitability
modelNodes.description: Menu sales, theoretical COGS and gross margin.
modelNodes.logic: Use effective recipe and normalized ingredient cost; expose missing recipe coverage.
alternatives: Source margin is retained as a comparison, not silently substituted for modeled margin.

modelNodes.label: SUM Data Quality Exceptions
modelNodes.description: Structural, mapping, coverage and business-rule exceptions.
modelNodes.logic: Every exception keeps source file, row, rule, severity and resolution state; no raw value is published in this architecture contract.

decisions.title: PO source authority
decisions.decision: Use Purchase Order Report as the PO authority and exclude Enterprise Purchase Order from the production set.
decisions.rationale: The enterprise report is empty in UAT; the regular report exposes status, quantities, dates, vendor, item and cost required by the control tower.

decisions.title: Layered model retained
decisions.decision: Keep RAW to STD to DIM/FACT to SUM as the production architecture.
decisions.rationale: It separates source fidelity, quality checks, conformed identity and reusable KPI logic while supporting Zoho Analytics ingestion.

decisions.title: Standing PO conditional
decisions.decision: Ingest Standing Purchase Order only if ABNAH uses it and release linkage is available.
decisions.rationale: Without release keys, standing-order analytics would create unprovable PO coverage and liability logic.

decisions.title: Planned versus reviewed lineage
decisions.decision: Keep this graph labeled planned until local structural and value validation passes.
decisions.rationale: Presentation readiness must not convert a feasible design into false evidence of implemented or approved mappings.
